ctx.x: Budd Johnson. We toured together again in Europe in later years. He was with Quincy's band, Quincy Jones' band. And Bud was very unhappy, he hadn't been home for quite a while. And actually Quincy stayed over there about two years. But that was a great band. They played for us, Nat Cole, and speaking of an all star band, Jerome Richardson, Shahab, Bud Johnson, Phil Woods, Lennie Johnson, it was just an exciting exciting band. It was a thrill to have them to travel with us.

But as I say in New York -- when I go to New York I have all of these memories, and it's just a thrill to get back there. And while living in New York I recorded with just about everybody. I recorded with Dinah Washington.
